content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've come across a new challenge and could use your help. I had an existing program and webpage that were working well. After making changes to the [product_name] web page and downloading them, the old page kept showing up instead of the updated version. I tried reformatting the 16GB SD card (FAT32), cleared browser caches, restarted the [product_name], saved the new program under a different name, and rebooted my computer, but nothing worked. No matter what I do, I keep seeing the old webpage instead of the new one. Any suggestions?
Could you upload your [product_name] project and [product_name] program as a ZIP file?

Hello [user_name], What version of [product_name] are you using? If it's [version_no], I recommend using this tool: Reset Tool for restoring [product_name] to its default state. Afterward, try downloading your project again.
How is resetting the base module related to the process of loading a webserver page?
Hello everyone, I believe I found the issue — the SD card was faulty. After reformatting it several times without success, I replaced it with a spare and everything works now.

Hello everyone, It looks like the problem was with the SD card, which was defective. Multiple attempts at formatting didn't help, but using a spare SD card fixed everything. A quick note: If you make changes in your [product_name] project and download it to [product_name], you also need to reload it in your web browser. The simplest method is to press F5, which forces the browser to reload all data from the web server and reflect the changes. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced persistent problems with updated webpages from [product_name] projects not displaying as intended, even after various troubleshooting steps such as SD card reformatting, browser cache clearing, and device/computer restarts. Ultimately, a malfunctioning SD card was identified as the main cause, highlighting a fragile reliance on hardware components. Some confusion was observed regarding the right steps to ensure new project content is properly published and visible, particularly concerning browser refresh and hardware dependencies.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that after updating and downloading a new web project, the updated webpage should be visible immediately and replace the previous version, without hidden issues linked to hardware faults or unclear processes.
